name: default
title: Journal
description: A quiet, typography-first journal for personal blogs and small-organisation news, whose signature is the type itself: a bookish display serif over a humanist sans body on a 65ch measure, with one deep-cobalt accent.

tokens.--font-display: headings and the site title — the bookish serif that is the theme's signature
tokens.--font-body: body text, the menu and the footer
tokens.--text-s: small text: dates, the menu, the footer, table headings
tokens.--text-l: the site title, small headings, and the tagline, quotes and buttons on a landing page
tokens.--text-xl: section headings, and post titles in a list
tokens.--text-xxl: the page title and the landing-page headline — grows with the screen, between the first and last value
tokens.--color-bg: page background, and the text on the main button
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text: dates, the menu, quotes, the footer
tokens.--color-accent: the one accent: links, tags, the rule beside a quote, buttons, and focus rings
tokens.--color-border: thin dividing lines: under the masthead, between posts, in tables, around cards
tokens.--color-code-bg: background of code, and of the tinted bands on a landing page
tokens.--measure: maximum width of the text column, masthead and footer
tokens.--measure-wide: maximum width of the sections on a landing page
tokens.--measure-lede: maximum width of the tagline under a landing-page headline
tokens.--measure-media: maximum width of the image under a landing-page headline
tokens.--space-1: hairline gap: under a post title in a list, inside the copy button
tokens.--space-2: small gap: under a page title, between tags, inside table cells
tokens.--space-3: page gutter on small screens, and the gap between paragraphs
tokens.--space-4: gap between blocks: above a heading, between posts, inside cards
tokens.--space-5: large gap above page titles and the footer, and around landing-page sections
tokens.--radius: corner rounding on images, code, buttons and cards (the focus ring uses half of it)
